mapper.select: WITH raw_days AS (SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS stat_date,SUM(event_type='PAGE_VIEW') AS pv,SUM(event_type='CONTENT_VIEW') AS cv FROM sr_analytics_event WHERE occurred_at < #{today} GROUP BY DATE(occurred_at)), raw_content AS (SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS stat_date,content_type,content_id,COUNT(*) AS total FROM sr_analytics_event WHERE event_type='CONTENT_VIEW' AND occurred_at < #{today} GROUP BY DATE(occurred_at),content_type,content_id), raw_referrer AS (SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS stat_date,referrer_category,COUNT(*) AS total FROM sr_analytics_event WHERE event_type='PAGE_VIEW' AND occurred_at < #{today} GROUP BY DATE(occurred_at),referrer_category) SELECT r.stat_date FROM raw_days r LEFT JOIN sr_analytics_daily_site d ON d.stat_date=r.stat_date WHERE d.stat_date IS NULL OR r.pv!=d.page_view_count OR r.cv!=d.content_view_count OR r.stat_date >= DATE_SUB(#{today},INTERVAL 3 DAY) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM raw_content c LEFT JOIN sr_analytics_daily_content a ON a.stat_date=c.stat_date AND a.content_type=c.content_type AND a.content_id=c.content_id WHERE c.stat_date=r.stat_date AND (a.stat_date IS NULL OR a.view_count!=c.total)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM raw_referrer c LEFT JOIN sr_analytics_daily_referrer a ON a.stat_date=c.stat_date AND a.referrer_category=c.referrer_category WHERE c.stat_date=r.stat_date AND (a.stat_date IS NULL OR a.view_count!=c.total)) OR r.cv!=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count),0) FROM sr_analytics_daily_content a WHERE a.stat_date=r.stat_date) OR r.pv!=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count),0) FROM sr_analytics_daily_referrer a WHERE a.stat_date=r.stat_date) ORDER BY r.stat_date
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_analytics_event WHERE occurred_at >= #{date} AND occurred_at < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_analytics_event(event_type, route_key, content_type, content_id, referrer_category, referrer_host) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{routeKey}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, COALESCE(#{referrerCategory}, 'DIRECT'), #{referrerHost})

INSERT INTO sr_analytics_daily_site(stat_date, page_view_count, content_view_count) SELECT #{date}, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'CONTENT_VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM sr_analytics_event WHERE occurred_at >= #{date} AND occurred_at < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

INSERT INTO sr_analytics_daily_content(stat_date, content_type, content_id, view_count) SELECT #{date}, content_type, content_id, COUNT(*) FROM sr_analytics_event WHERE event_type = 'CONTENT_VIEW' AND occurred_at >= #{date} AND occurred_at < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY content_type, content_id

INSERT INTO sr_analytics_daily_referrer(stat_date, referrer_category, view_count) SELECT #{date}, referrer_category, COUNT(*) FROM sr_analytics_event WHERE event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW' AND occurred_at >= #{date} AND occurred_at < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY referrer_category
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW'),0) AS pageViews, COALESCE(SUM(event_type = 'CONTENT_VIEW'),0) AS contentViews FROM sr_analytics_event WHERE occurred_at >= #{today} AND occurred_at < DATE_ADD(#{today}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT stat_date AS statDate, page_view_count AS pageViews, content_view_count AS contentViews FROM sr_analytics_daily_site WHERE stat_date >= #{start} AND stat_date <= #{end} AND stat_date < #{today} ORDER BY stat_date
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sr_analytics_event WHERE occurred_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1000
